title: Hugging Bay: Torrent Catalog But For AI Models
description:
Downloading AI models is basically torrenting now and honestly its kinda genius 🔥

Someone built Hugging Bay, a full torrent catalog just for AI. Open models, datasets, apps and other tools all sitting in one place, you grab them directly or through trusted mirrors.

The part that sold me: there's filters by task and by hardware, and the search actualy understands normal human language. You type "small model for translation" and it just gives you the right thing, no digging ✨

And no its not piracy. Only publicly available files, proper licenses and verified hashes so nothing sketchy 😅

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
